meta.name: description
meta.content: yunz / يونس — fast, private web workspace

link.href: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Crect width='32' height='32' rx='8' fill='%230a0a0c'/%3E%3Ctext x='16' y='21' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='700' fill='%23f4f4f6' text-anchor='middle'%3Ey%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

div.div: Click anywhere or press Enter to continue

form.div: Enter access code to open workspace
form.label: Access PIN

div.p: Private workspace, fast relay browsing, TikTok interactivity, and keyless AI.

input.placeholder: Search Bing or type any website (e.g. tiktok, youtube.com)...

div.p: Curated destinations routed cleanly through the active relay.
Add, edit, delete, and reorder your personal shortcuts.
Play web games directly in the workspace frame.
Video, music, radio, and streaming portals.

section.div: Note: Media platforms below open inside the proxied browser frame rather than native built-in audio/video playback.

div.p: Saved pages synced with the toolbar star toggle.
Visited URLs in this browser workspace.
All preferences persist locally in your browser.

div.div: Switch between obsidian dark and paper light surfaces.
Subtle focus rings and active highlights.
Adjust card and input corner rounding.
Collapse desktop sidebar labels to icons by default.
Display pinned apps below the Home search box.
Disable hover transforms and transitions for lower battery draw.
Synced with omnibox and Home search pills.
Show matching apps, bookmarks, history, and directory shortcuts as you type.
Stop adding newly visited URLs to local history.
Filter known ad networks inside proxied pages while preserving TikTok interactivity.
Remove history or lock workspace immediately.
Benchmark fastest Wisp endpoint or clear Service Worker/browser caches.

div.p: Clean Scramjet + Wisp portal with TikTok interactivity protection, keyless Pollinations AI, and Tesseract Screen Solver. PIN checks use salted SHA-256 on static portals and timing-safe HMAC session cookies on Node server deployments.
Speed-tuned web workspace across GitHub Pages, SVG CDNs, and Node Fastify.
• Instant dark entry screen paired with 3-attempt persistent lockout gate.
• Lazy Scramjet + multi-relay US Wisp proxy so the UI paints before proxy initialization.
• Dedicated TikTok repost/interactivity restoration module inside proxied frames.
• Bing default search with keyboard-accessible suggestions, bookmarks, history, custom apps, and 7-tab settings.
• Keyless AI Assistant with live web context and Document Picture-in-Picture Screen Solver.

iframe.title: Proxied web viewport
iframe.allow: fullscreen; autoplay; clipboard-read; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; gamepad

div.div: Hello! I am yunz AI. I can search the web, analyze uploaded images/files, and solve questions without any API key.

input.placeholder: Ask anything or paste an image...
Ask about what is on your screen...

div.div: Select any test or study tab to scan and solve.
